tasks.short: Prepare functional and technical warehouse documentation.

steps.what: Verify actual warehouse implementation and capture undocumented functional meaning, exceptions and operating requirements
inputs: actual warehouse schemas, pipeline definitions and approved business requirements
outputs: specialist-verified implementation references and actual functional explanations

steps.what: Generate exact warehouse schema, lineage and configuration tables using native catalog documentation exports
inputs: specialist-verified implementation references and actual functional explanations

steps.what: Draft functional explanations and operating notes from actual verified implementation and specialist explanations
inputs: specialist-verified implementation references and actual functional explanations

loop.purpose: Draft variable functional and operating prose from actual warehouse evidence
loop.input: Versioned implementation references, exact tables and specialist-captured explanations
loop.output: Documentation prose with source references and explicitly unresolved points
loop.check: Specialist checks every operational instruction, business meaning, omission and implied capability against actual implementation; identifiers alone do not prove meaning
loop.stop: Missing source, contradictory implementation or two failed corrections return the affected prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native exports cover schema tables first; variable functional and exception explanations require bounded language drafting

steps.what: Revise and approve complete final functional and technical warehouse documentation version
inputs: specialist-verified implementation references and actual functional explanations
outputs: approved complete final warehouse documentation version and internal location

steps.what: Commit approved complete final warehouse documentation to its approved internal location
inputs: approved complete final warehouse documentation version and internal location

tasks.design: Configure native catalog documentation exports first. Generate exact schema and configuration tables without recopying; bounded prose drafting uses actual versioned implementation and fully counted specialist explanations. The specialist checks complete operational meaning and revises the whole final document before approval and separate internal commit. Documentation never applies a warehouse configuration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated metadata copying and first explanation writing across technical documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalog exports plus source-bound language drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Correct business semantics, operational limits and undocumented exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing whether a plausible operating instruction actually matches the running warehouse.
tasks.altitude: Less documentation assembly with complete semantic review retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogs can export schema documentation and bounded language tools can draft explanations from actual implementation; this combined design is proposed.

assumptions: Shares and remaining effort are provisional; confirm residual table copying and first writing after current catalog tools. Existing export runtime earns no saving.

Actual catalog and pipeline definitions provide object_id, field_name, type, dependency, version and configuration. s1 fully counts verification and missing functional explanation capture; absent metadata is filled manually. No structured explanation or correct operational fact appears free.

s3 retains 15 hours for substantive prose checks; s4 retains 24 hours for complete table, omission, meaning and instruction review plus actual corrections. Missing sources and failed loops return writing to manual.

The complete final combined document and exact internal location exist before approval. Any text or location change voids approval. Same-system commit remains full effort; its share is schema granularity, not measured click cost.
unknowns: Actual review burden for generated prose
research_questions: Which documentation sections still require repeated copying or first drafting after native exports?
Does source-bound drafting reduce net effort after full functional review?

incremental.description: Maintain documentation mappings and audit source-bound prose failures

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final combined warehouse documentation and exact internal location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35 exact-table copying plus 25 times 40% prose benefit = 45 less 2 upkeep = 43. Low keeps prose manual and halves table benefit: 17.5 less 2 = 15.5; provisional, not a measured baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Warehouse specialists spend less time assembling documentation while retaining implementation truth and complete functional review.
reach: Users receive documentation whose approved version references actual warehouse evidence.
role.ambitious_version: Actual warehouse schemas, functional intent and operating limits stay linked to a reviewed final documentation version.
